name: Escritorio de encino con cajonera
adaptations: Solid oak is written in T18 plywood.
Finish: matte oil or wax look, closest id danish-oil.
Only the front corners of the top are rounded: the back ones stay square, where the legs and the pedestal reach the edge. The rounded edge becomes square.
Fluted drawer fronts (two lower) become flat; recessed slot pulls become finger notches.
Pedestal hangs from the top and rests on a rail in the original; here it is a standard pedestal.
Depth 650 estimated from the photos; height 750 assumed (no measure given).

splayed A-frame legs with stretchers drawn as two legs with an apron and a low stretcher on the side that has no pedestal: the front one leans out and thins toward the foot, the back one stays straight
notes: En Knotty queda como un escritorio de 150 × 65 cm en triplay, con cajonera de tres cajones con muesca a la derecha y dos patas con faldón y travesaño bajo a la izquierda: la del frente se abre hacia afuera. Las esquinas del frente de la cubierta van redondeadas. El original es de encino macizo, con patas en A.
